Subject: FinTechX POC Observability Plan — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Sara / James — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC observability plan so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and ownership.

1) POC goal / success criteria (proposed)
- Functionality: Redwood hosted inference meets FinTechX production traffic patterns for chat and structured generation (up to 5k requests/day).
- Performance: p95 end-to-end latency < 800ms for standard request (avg 120 tokens), p50 < 250ms.
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% sustained over 24h windows.
- Cost: token cost <= target (we'll include modeled cost per 1k tokens in the SOW).
- Observability: dashboards and alerts demonstrate ability to detect regressions (latency, error spikes, cache misses) within 5 minutes.

2) Evaluation plan / instrumentation (Redwood deliverables)
- Dashboards: pre-built Grafana/Looker dashboards showing per-route latency (p50/p95/p99), token-level cost breakdown, throughput, request rate, model fallback counts, cache hit rate. (Attachment: sample-dashboards.png)
- Tracing: request-level traces (OpenTelemetry) with correlation id, sampled at 1% by default; adjustable during POC. Traces will surface model inference time vs network/queuing time.
- Logs & exports: structured request logs (JSON) with tenant_id, request_id, model_version, prompt_length, token_count. We can export via S3/GCS or stream to Splunk via HTTP/syslog.
- Metrics to monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, requests/sec, error rate (4xx/5xx), token consumption, GPU utilization, queue depth, KV cache hit rate, model fallback count, cold-starts.
- Alerts & runbook: thresholds for latency and error rate; Redwood will provide an initial runbook and we’ll iterate on thresholds with your SREs.

3) Ownership & roles
- FinTechX: Sara (PM) — acceptance criteria and UAT; James (Infra) — Splunk ingestion and SSO checks; Security team (cced) — compliance questions and retention policy.
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) — program lead; Marcus (SE) & Aditya (SRE/SE) — instrumentation, dashboards, and runbook; Eng on-call for support during ramp.

4) Timeline (proposed)
- 7/19: kickoff (instrumentation & access).
- 7/20–7/24: integration & dashboard setup; Splunk export configured.
- 7/25–8/01: validation & UAT with FinTechX test suite; collect metrics.
- 8/02: POC wrap, success review, and next steps (expand to dedicated capacity if successful).

5) Next steps (action items)
- Sara/James: confirm owners and OK the proposed success criteria and timeline.
- FinTechX: share Splunk endpoint details (or S3 bucket credentials) and list of sample tenant_ids for test traffic.
- Redwood: share SOW and dashboard links prior to kickoff (attached: redwood-poc-observability-template.xlsx).

Attachments: redwood-poc-observability-template.xlsx (instrumentation checklist), sample-dashboards.png

Thanks — happy to adjust anything. If we get quick confirmations we can lock the kickoff for 7/19 at 10:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Sara / James — following up with concrete answers and a slightly adjusted plan based on your asks.

1) Retention / compliance
- Retention is configurable per tenant. We support 90/180/365 day retention tiers. For SOC 2 evidence we can produce audit logs and access reports; we'll include retention options in the SOW.

2) Splunk export options
- Two options:
  a) Direct stream via HTTP/syslog (preferred for real-time) — we can set up an ingestion endpoint and send structured JSON logs.
  b) S3/GCS export (batched) + your forwarder — lower real-time fidelity but easier firewall setup.
- We'll coordinate on credentials and whitelist IPs at kickoff.

3) Tracing
- Default sample rate: 1% (low overhead). We can increase to 10% for test windows; Marcus/Aditya can toggle sampling for the time-limited stress window.

4) Proposed success criteria (tighter wording)
- p95 end-to-end latency < 800ms for production-like requests (avg 120 tokens).
- p50 < 250ms.
- Sustained error rate < 0.5% (5xx and model-fallbacks) over rolling 24h windows.
- No more than 2 unplanned model fallbacks per 10k requests.
- Observability: alerts fire and on-call is paged within 5 minutes of crossing thresholds.

5) Ownership & timeline (updated)
- If you need to shift, proposed new kickoff: 2026-07-26. POC window: 2026-07-26 -> 2026-08-09 (two weeks).
- Redwood will deliver: dashboard links, initial alerts & runbook, Splunk ingestion config, S3 sink (if chosen), and a short training session for your SREs.
- FinTechX will deliver: Splunk endpoint or S3 creds, sample tenant_ids/test dataset, and access to any internal services required for correlation.

6) Attachments / SOW
- Attached: poc-observability-sow.pdf (draft scope + SLO table). Please review and flag any changes.

If that all looks good I can update the SOW with the 7/26 kickoff and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
